integrity: The infinite family follows symbolically from an exact base bimodule decomposition, published tensor-product theorems, and the tensor radical formula. The bundled computation checks only the fixed five-dimensional base algebra.
scientific_limitations: The all-positive realization is proved for perfect fields with \(\operatorname{char}k\ne2\), because the tensor-product theorems invoked from the source are stated with that characteristic restriction. Characteristic \(2\) and the negative-gap question are not settled.
title: Tensor powers of the basic non-controllable extension realize every positive ideal-gap
